verdict.rationale: LlamaParse is API-first: one API key works across a REST API, SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go, Java and C#, and a CLI tool, all suited to headless scripting. Webhooks remove the need to poll for job status, batch processing is documented, and Helm-based self-hosting supports automated infrastructure. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guidance (e.g., GitHub Actions or non-interactive auth docs), independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.
